WELCOME TO KILKIVAN BUSH CAMPING
The Natural Place to Stay
Kilkivan Bush Camping & Caravan Park is our home and we warmly welcome you to share its delights with us. With an extensive choice of large powered and unpowered grassy sites, Glamping Chalets and Safari Cabins, swimming pool, abundant native gardens, modern amenities, Aussie Bush Bar, colourful playgrounds, meandering creek (seasonal), delicious catered meals and extensive variety of bird and wildlife, this park is designed with your comfort, enjoyment and relaxation in mind.

Safari Cabins
The Natural Place to Stay
SITE OVERVIEW
Safari Cabins
Our Safari Cabins are designed for the traveller who would like to experience the great outdoors with a little extra comfort. Perfect to unplug and disconnect.
​
Featuring your own private court yard to enjoy our beautiful bush setting. Each Safari Cabin sleeps up to 4 people with power available. Each Safari Cabin is equipped with lights, ceiling fan and bar fridge.
​
Please note that you must supply your own linen (Queen Bed and single bunk). Situated near the camp kitchen and close to amenities. Pets welcome - please note conditions.

Facilities

VIEW FACILITIES
Check Availability & Make a Booking
Book Now
Email enquiry
Our park is closed each February for regeneration, revegetation and maintenance. This gives us the opportunity to consistently improve our park and grounds to make sure our guests have the most enjoyable camping experience. For any future bookings do not hesitate to put through an enquiry as one of our friendly staff will be monitoring emails on a weekly basis to reply.
Check In Times
Check in is from 2PM 5PM (outside these hours please contact us to make alternative arrangements, we can leave a key in the door and a map at the office).

About Kilkivan Bush Camp
The Natural Place to Stay
ABOUT US
The Natural Place to Stay
Kilkivan Bush Camping & Caravan Park is our home and we warmly welcome you to share its delights with us. With an extensive choice of large powered and unpowered grassy sites, large established trees providing great shade and habitats, abundant native gardens, Aussie Bush Bar, colourful playgrounds, meandering seasonal creek, lovely pool with shade sail, catered meals and an abundance of birds and wildlife, this park is designed with your comfort, enjoyment and relaxation in mind.
Our large family prides itself on creating a wonderful space that is friendly, relaxed and social, with plenty of space for the youngest guest to the oldest well seasoned traveller. It is a pet friendly park, with space to let the family dog run and play, and campfires to complete the authentic camping adventure.
So head on out and experience the delights that our unique Australian bush has to offer without having to forgo the creature comforts
